<p>需求背景：需要在Taro小程序中给图片根据坐标增加标注信息，并实现图片的放大缩小，切换下一页功能。</p>
<p>实现技术：Taro、Canvas</p>
<p>实现代码</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>const [swiperCurrent, setSwiperCurrent] = useState(0) <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 图片页码</span>
const [imgList, setImgList] = useState([]) <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 图片数据</span>
const [isMoving, setIsMoving] = useState(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 图片是否移动</span>
const [lastTouch, setLastTouch] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0 }) <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 最后触摸的坐标</span>
const [lastDistance, setLastDistance] = useState(0) <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 最后缩放</span>
const scale = useRef(1) <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 放大倍数</span>
const position = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0 }) <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 图片移动的位置</span>
const canvasRef = useRef(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
const ctxRef </span>= useRef(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

const currentImgObjRef = useRef(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 当前图片对象</span>
const lastClickTimeRef = useRef(0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)

useEffect(() </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    geImgtList()
}, [])

const geImgtList </span>= async () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
  const img </span>= [{ url: 'http://e.hiphotos.baidu.com/image/pic/item/a1ec08fa513d2697e542494057fbb2fb4316d81e.jpg'，coord：[ [10, 10], [ 20, 20 ] ], suspectCode: '标注的文字'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> }] 
  setImgList(img)
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(!!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">img.length) {
     const currentImage </span>= img[0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">];
     currentImageRef.current </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> currentImage
     </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
          const localImagePath </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> await loadBgImg(currentImage.url)
          await initCanvas(localImagePath, currentImage.coord, currentImage .suspectCode)
        } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (error) {
          console.error(</span>'图片加载失败:'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, error)
        }
   }
}

 const loadBgImg </span>= async (imgUrl) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (imageCacheRef.current.has(imgUrl)) {
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> imageCacheRef.current.get(imgUrl)
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
      const res </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> await Taro.downloadFile({
        url: imgUrl
      })
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (res.statusCode === 200<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
        imageCacheRef.current.set(imgUrl, res.tempFilePath)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> res.tempFilePath
      } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Error(`下载失败: ${res.statusCode}`)
      }
    } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (error) {
      console.error(</span>'图片加载失败:'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, error)
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throw</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> error
    }
  }

 const initCanvas </span>= (imagePath, coordinates = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span>, suspectCode) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Promise((resolve, reject) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
      Taro.createSelectorQuery()
      .select(</span>'#myCanvas'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
      .fields({ node: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span>, size: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> })
      .exec((res) </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (res[0] &amp;&amp; res[0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">].node) {
          const canvas </span>= res[0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">].node
          canvasRef.current </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> canvas
          const ctx </span>= canvas.getContext('2d'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
          ctxRef.current </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ctx
          const canvasWidth </span>= res[0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">].width
          const canvasHeight </span>= res[0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">].height
          
          const dpr </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Taro.getSystemInfoSync().pixelRatio
          canvas.width </span>= canvasWidth *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> dpr
          canvas.height </span>= canvasHeight *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> dpr
          ctx.scale(dpr, dpr)
          
          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建图片对象并保存引用</span>
          const img =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> canvas.createImage()
          currentImgObjRef.current </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> img
          
          img.onload </span>= () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
              drawImage(img, coordinates, suspectCode)
              resolve()
            } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (error) {
              console.error(</span>'绘制图片时出错:'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, error)
              reject(error)
            }
          }
          
          img.onerror </span>= (error) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
            console.error(</span>'图片加载失败:'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, error)
            reject(error)
          }
          
          img.src </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> imagePath
        } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
          console.error(</span>'无法获取 canvas 节点'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
          reject(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Error('无法获取 canvas 节点'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">))
        }
      })
    })
  }

    
  const drawImage </span>= (img, coordinates = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span>, suspectCode) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!canvasRef.current || !ctxRef.current) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

    const canvas </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> canvasRef.current
    const ctx </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ctxRef.current
    const canvasWidth </span>= canvas.width / (Taro.getSystemInfoSync().pixelRatio || 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    const canvasHeight </span>= canvas.height / (Taro.getSystemInfoSync().pixelRatio || 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 计算自适应尺寸</span>
    const imgWidth =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> img.width
    const imgHeight </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> img.height
    
    const scaleX </span>= canvasWidth /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> imgWidth
    const scaleY </span>= canvasHeight /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> imgHeight
    const baseScale </span>= Math.min(scaleX, scaleY, 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 应用当前缩放</span>
    const currentScale = baseScale *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> scale.current
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 计算绘制尺寸</span>
    const drawWidth = imgWidth *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> currentScale
    const drawHeight </span>= imgHeight *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> currentScale
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 计算位置 - 垂直居中并应用偏移</span>
    const baseX = (canvasWidth - drawWidth) / 2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    const baseY </span>= (canvasHeight - drawHeight) / 2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    const x </span>= baseX +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> position.current.x
    const y </span>= baseY +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> position.current.y

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 清空画布</span>
    ctx.clearRect(0, 0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, canvasWidth, canvasHeight)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 绘制图片</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    ctx.drawImage(img, x, y, drawWidth, drawHeight)
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 如果有坐标信息，绘制边框</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (coordinates &amp;&amp; coordinates.length &gt;= 2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
      const [x1, y1] </span>= coordinates[0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">];
      const [x2, y2] </span>= coordinates[1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">];
      
      const scaledX1 </span>= x + (x1 / imgWidth) *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> drawWidth;
      const scaledY1 </span>= y + (y1 / imgHeight) *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> drawHeight;
      const scaledX2 </span>= x + (x2 / imgWidth) *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> drawWidth;
      const scaledY2 </span>= y + (y2 / imgHeight) *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> drawHeight;
      
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 绘制矩形边框</span>
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#2e9cef'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
      ctx.lineWidth </span>= 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
      ctx.strokeRect(
        scaledX1,
        scaledY1,
        scaledX2 </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> scaledX1,
        scaledY2 </span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> scaledY1
      );
      
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 绘制 suspectCode 文本</span>
      let text =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> suspectCode
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (text) {
        ctx.font </span>= '14px Microsoft YaHei'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        ctx.fillStyle </span>= '#2e9cef'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        ctx.textAlign </span>= 'left'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        ctx.textBaseline </span>= 'bottom'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        
        const textX </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> scaledX1;
        const textY </span>= scaledY1 - 5<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        
        ctx.fillText(text, textX, textY);
      }
    }
  }

   </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 单指触摸 - 移动</span>
  const handleTouchStart = (e) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (e.touches.length === 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
      const touch </span>= e.touches[0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]
      setLastTouch({ x: touch.clientX, y: touch.clientY })
      setIsMoving(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (e.touches.length === 2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 双指触摸 - 缩放</span>
      const touch1 = e.touches[0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]
      const touch2 </span>= e.touches[1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]
      const distance </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Math.sqrt(
        Math.pow(touch2.clientX </span>- touch1.clientX, 2) +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 
        Math.pow(touch2.clientY </span>- touch1.clientY, 2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
      )
      setLastDistance(distance)
    }
  }

  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 移动</span>
  const handleTouchMove = (e) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (e.touches.length === 1 &amp;&amp;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> isMoving) {
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 单指移动</span>
      const touch = e.touches[0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]
      const deltaX </span>= touch.clientX -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> lastTouch.x
      const deltaY </span>= touch.clientY -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> lastTouch.y
      
      position.current </span>= { x: position.current.x + deltaX, y: position.current.y +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> deltaY }
      
      setLastTouch({ x: touch.clientX, y: touch.clientY })
      
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 立即重绘</span>
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (currentImgObjRef.current) {
        const currentImage </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> currentImageRef.current
        drawImage(currentImgObjRef.current, currentImage</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.coord, currentImage.suspectCode)
      }
    } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (e.touches.length === 2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 双指缩放</span>
      const touch1 = e.touches[0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]
      const touch2 </span>= e.touches[1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">]
      const distance </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Math.sqrt(
        Math.pow(touch2.clientX </span>- touch1.clientX, 2) +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 
        Math.pow(touch2.clientY </span>- touch1.clientY, 2<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
      )
      
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (lastDistance &gt; 0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
        const scaleFactor </span>= distance /<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> lastDistance
        const newScale </span>= Math.max(0.5, Math.min(3, scale.current *<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> scaleFactor))
        
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (newScale !==<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> scale.current) {</span>
          scale.current =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> newScale
          
          </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 立即重绘</span>
          <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (currentImgObjRef.current) {
            const currentImage </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> currentImageRef.current
            drawImage(currentImgObjRef.current, currentImage</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.coord, currentImage.suspectCode)
          }
        }
      }
      
      setLastDistance(distance)
    }
  }

  const handleTouchEnd </span>= () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    setIsMoving(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    setLastDistance(</span>0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
  }
  
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 双击图片回到图片初始大小</span>
  const handleClick = () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    const currentTime </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Date().getTime();
    const timeDiff </span>= currentTime -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> lastClickTimeRef.current;<br>    // 点击时长
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(timeDiff &lt; 200<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
      resetTransform()
    }
     lastClickTimeRef.current </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> currentTime;
  }

   </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 重置缩放和位置</span>
  const resetTransform = () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (!currentImgObjRef.current) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span>
    
    scale.current = 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    position.current </span>= { x: 0, y: 0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> }
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 立即重绘</span>
    const currentImage =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> currentImageRef.current
    drawImage(currentImgObjRef.current, currentImage</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.coord, currentImage .suspectCode)
  }

   </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 处理图片切换</span>
  const handleSwiperChange = async (idx) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 切换图片时重置缩放和位置</span>
    scale.current = 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    position.current </span>= { x: 0, y: 0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> }
    
    const currentImage </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> imgData.imgList[idx];
    currentImageRef.current </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> currentImage
    
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
      const localImagePath </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> await loadBgImg(currentImage.url)
      const img </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> canvasRef.current.createImage()
      currentImgObjRef.current </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> img
      
      img.onload </span>= () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        drawImage(img, currentImage.coord, currentImage.suspectCode)
      }
      img.onerror </span>= () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
        console.error(</span>'切换图片加载失败'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
      }
      img.src </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> localImagePath
    } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (error) {
      console.error(</span>'切换图片失败:'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, error)
    }
  } 

 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 左滑</span>
  const canvasLeftClick = () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    let idx </span>= 0
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">swiperCurrent) {
      idx </span>= imgList.length - 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
      idx </span>= swiperCurrent - 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    }
    setSwiperCurrent(idx)        
    handleSwiperChange(idx)
  }
 
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 右滑</span>
  const canvasRightClick = () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    let idx </span>= 0
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(swiperCurrent === imgList.length - 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) {
      idx </span>= 0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    } </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
      idx </span>= swiperCurrent + 1<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    }
    setSwiperCurrent(idx)        
    handleSwiperChange(idx)
  }

  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> （
     </span>&lt;View&gt;
        &lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Canvas
          id</span>="myCanvas"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
          type</span>="2d"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
          onTouchStart</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{handleTouchStart}
          onTouchMove</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{handleTouchMove}
          onTouchEnd</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{handleTouchEnd}
          onTouchCancel</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{handleTouchEnd}
          onClick</span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">{handleClick}
        </span>/&gt;
      &lt;View className='canvas-left' onClick={canvasLeftClick}&gt;
        &lt;Image src='/img/left.png' className='canvas-arrow-icon'&gt;&lt;/Image&gt;
      &lt;/View&gt;
      &lt;View className='canvas-right' onClick={canvasRightClick}&gt;
        &lt;Image src='/img/right.png' className='canvas-arrow-icon'&gt;&lt;/Image&gt;
      &lt;/View&gt;
    &lt;/View&gt;    
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">   ）

#myCanvas {
    width: </span>100%<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    height: 100vh;
    background: rgba(</span>0, 0, 0, 0.8<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
  }
  .canvas</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">left {
    width: 150px;
    height: 150px;
    position: fixed;
    top: </span>50%<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    left: 10px;
    transform: translateY(</span>-50%<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    z</span>-index: 10<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    line</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">height: 150px;
    text</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">align: left;
    .canvas</span>-arrow-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">icon {
      width: 80px;
      height: 80px;
    }
  }
  .canvas</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">right {
    width: 150px;
    height: 150px;
    position: fixed;
    top: </span>50%<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    right: 10px;
    transform: translateY(</span>-50%<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    z</span>-index: 10<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    line</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">height: 150px;
    text</span>-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">align: right;
    .canvas</span>-arrow-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">icon {
      width: 80px;
      height: 80px;
    }
  }</span></pre>
</div>
<p>以上就是全部代码</p>
<p>项目上线后还遇到一个问题：在微信小程序上看不到图片，经过排查是因为后端使用的图片的域名是新加的，需要在小程序后台设置downloadFile 的合法域名。</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
